page.name: A Message in Blood
page.objective: Slay 12 Meadowsbrook Farmhands, then return to Krom'rosh with news of your success.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Slay 12 Meadowsbrook Farmhands, then return to Krom'rosh with news of your success. | Meadowsbrook Farmhand slain | : | 0/ | 12 | Description | Does your blade thirst for human blood, â€¹nameâ€º? | Some years ago, the human defectors laid claim to a small farm to the southwest across the river. With the area rich in lumber and stone, it was only a matter of time before they expanded their reach to the keep along the eastern shore known as Farholde. | Our first skirmishes would have ended in our favor if we'd had the numbers. It's time to remind them of our presence. | Disrupt their farming efforts. Take no prisoners. Send them a clear message.

page.name: Food for the Taking
page.objective: Steal 6 Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Steal 6 Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh. | 6 | Feed Satchel | Description | Humans within these lands have long enjoyed the warmth, comfort and sustenance these lands provide. It's time we start denying these humans such pleasantries. | Seek out the supplies of our enemies at the farm to the southwest. Take whatever you find. | It won't bring pleasure like bloodying a blade, but slowing them buys us time to plan our next move. | When you come back | Returned with our supplies? | When you hand it in | Smells of earth and root, yes? Not pleasant, but we do what we must to survive. | Throwing this into a boiling cauldron with fish and wild grass makes the pains of hunger retreat like cowardly human dogs.

page.name: Borrowed Blades
page.objective: Retrieve 10 Woodworker's Axe from the lumberjacks at Turner's Logging Camp for Kreza Darkthorn in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Retrieve 10 Woodworker's Axe from the lumberjacks at Turner's Logging Camp for Kreza Darkthorn in Rog'mar. | 10 | Woodworker's Axe | Description | With the human presence to the south and Twilight to the west, the battle for resources has become difficult. But why gather resources amongst our enemies when their blades will suffice? | Follow the river south to the mill. When you hear the whistling of woodworkers among the trees, tread lightly. When the opportunity presents itself, strike hard and fast. | I'll stay behind to keep the forge running hot. Gur'dok will break down the blades while I fashion weaponry forged of their own materials. | When you come back | Have you retrieved what we discussed? | When you hand it in | The blood on these blades is still fresh. Impressive. | How long do you think it will take for the humans to realize we've been using their own weapons against them?

page.name: The Goblin Trader
page.objective: Deliver the blade to Kreza Darkthorn's acquaintance at the docks east of Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the blade to Kreza Darkthorn's acquaintance at the docks east of Rog'mar. | Provided: | Beguiler's Blade | Description | While Gur'dok and I continue our work, we did fashion a particular blade for a friend--perhaps friend is too strong a word--for an acquaintance down at the docks. This particular individual is well known and connected all across the Kingdoms and beyond. | Take this. When you deliver it, let her know I sent you. And tell her we're even. | When you come back | A delivery on behalf of the horde, eh? You must be with Kreza. | When you hand it in | Hey there! Nice to meet ya! | Did Kreza really say we're even? That's cute.

page.name: A Gift From Our Enemies
page.objective: Deliver the Stolen Feed to Gorg in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the Stolen Feed to Gorg in Rog'mar. | Stolen Feed | Description | The humans of these lands are only one of many threats. With the encroaching Twilight and snarls of gnolls echoing from the hills nearby, battle may call at a moment's notice. Maintaining the strength of our allies may be the difference between Rog'mar's success or our removal from these lands. | Deliver the goods you've gathered to Gorg. He'll make sure our allies are well fed. | When you hand it in | Pungent. Earthy. And something a bit unpleasant. It appears you've been ransacking the farmstead, â€¹nameâ€º. | This will make for a hearty stew in no time.

page.name: A Serving of Strength
page.objective: Feed 8 Rog'mar Trainees at the training grounds.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Feed 8 Rog'mar Trainees at the training grounds. | Rog'mar Trainee fed | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | This hearty stew keeps our trainees fed, enough so that our enemies remain at a distance. | Bring this and feed our trainees to the west. Don't listen to any complaints. With how difficult defending our supply lines has become, they should be so lucky we're not feeding them dirt. | When you hand it in | Any more complaints and they can bring them to me directly. | I am thankful for your work in retrieving this food, as are our warriors, despite what they say.

page.name: Show Them How It's Done
page.objective: Slay 8 Farholde Priests and 12 Farholde Scouts south of the river.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Slay 8 Farholde Priests and 12 Farholde Scouts south of the river. | Farholde Priest slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Farholde Scout slain | : | 0/ | 12 | Description | Our scouts have reported training camps by the river to the south. If I'd received word sooner, it would have saved us both the hassle of locating and removing the human filth in a timely manner. | Continue your efforts, â€¹nameâ€º. Holding back the humans to their precious little keep will buy us time to focus on other matters at hand. | Be swift about it. | Rewards | Money: | 35 | 0 gold, 35 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,000 | When you hand it in | Swift work. Now let's continue our momentum elsewhere.

page.name: Gnoll Infestation
page.objective: Kill 8 Redridge Mystics, 8 Redridge Trappers, and 6 Redridge Brutes for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 8 Redridge Mystics, 8 Redridge Trappers, and 6 Redridge Brutes for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar. | Redridge Mystic slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Redridge Trapper slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Redridge Brute slain | : | 0/ | 6 | Description | Though the gnoll presence has dwindled with the Twilight's encroachment, the threat remains. | The hills to the southwest are infested with their kind, disrupting trades and travelers alike. | Clear a path for our allies by removing the threat. | When you hand it in | The scent of gnolls is not one that washes away easily.

page.name: Snargl's Snout
page.objective: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout. | Snargl's Snout | Description | Among the cackling inhabitants of the Bristle Hills southwest of here is an elder gnoll by the name of Snargl. The sounds emanating from this particular gnoll are quite unpleasant. Their presence inspires those around, creating a problem for allies and scouts who enter the area. | A trophy as a memento of our having dealt with this most unpleasant gnoll fiend would fit nicely with my collection. | Be swift about it, â€¹nameâ€º. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Bristlepelt Vest | Gnoll Crusher Leggings | Bloodsnout Striker | Gnollblood Robe | Experience: | 3,150 | When you come back | Found my new trophy yet? | When you hand it in | Heavier than I expected, but a wonderful addition no less.

page.objective: Gather 40 Stolen Ore from gnolls in the Bristle Hills for Kreza Darkthorn.

Take it from their dead bodies if need be. | Rewards | Money: | 45 | 0 gold, 45 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 2,850 | When you come back | Have you located the stolen ore? | When you hand it in | You've done well, â€¹nameâ€º. The scorching heat from our flame will remove any markings or scent that remains.

page.name: Jom-jom's Escape
page.objective: Escort Jom-jom to Clugfist at Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Escort Jom-jom to Clugfist at Bolder'ok. | Help Jom-jom reach Bolder'ok | Description | Jom-jom came looking for friend. page.name: My Kingdom for a Horse
page.objective: Go to Wheeler's Grange to inquire about the missing horses.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Go to Wheeler's Grange to inquire about the missing horses. | Description | Our warhorses come from two nearby farms. One of them, owned by the Wheeler family off the road just outside of town, has apparently lost all of their stock. The cause of this is currently unknown. | With no horses, we have no cavalry, and without cavalry, our campaign against the Horde stands no chance. | Thus, you see, this situation must be resolved with utmost haste. Of where to start, however, I am less sure. | Go to Wheeler's Grange and speak to Benjy. See what he has to say for himself.

page.name: Freshwater Fiends
page.objective: Kill 8 Mudfin Oracles and 8 Mudfin Warriors along the river near Wheeler's Grange.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 8 Mudfin Oracles and 8 Mudfin Warriors along the river near Wheeler's Grange. | Mudfin Warrior slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Mudfin Oracle slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | You seen those murlocs down by the river, just west of here? Nasty things. Bad for my animals, and bad for the wildlife. Not to mention, they've settled right on top of my favorite fishing spot! | There ain't a soul in the Riverglades who wouldn't appreciate you getting rid of a few, that's for sure. | Please, kill any you see. You'd be doin' us a whole heap of good. | Rewards | Money: | 20 | 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 2,850 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Foal Play
page.objective: Search near the stables at Wheeler's Grange for evidence of the missing horses' whereabouts.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Search near the stables at Wheeler's Grange for evidence of the missing horses' whereabouts. | Pawprint Tracing | Description | I've got no idea what happened to our horses. I got up one morning to feed 'em and they were all gone, just like that. | Life outside Farholde's a bit rougher. Anything could've got 'em--animals, murlocs, orcs, you name it. | If we wanna narrow down our list of culprits, we oughta search around the stables for clues.

page.name: Coyote Huntin'
page.objective: Kill the coyote known as Sootfur, and bring its pelt back to Benjy Wheeler.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill the coyote known as Sootfur, and bring its pelt back to Benjy Wheeler. | Sootfur's Pelt | Description | There's a pack of coyotes livin' in a den west of here. We can see 'em sometimes from across the river. They used to hunt fish on the shore, but I guess the murlocs pushed 'em out of their usual feeding ground, and so they've taken to eating horses. | The leader of the coyote pack's a bigger one with dark fur. We'd nicknamed him "Sootfur". I reckon if you kill him, the rest'll scatter.

page.name: Wheeler's Fleeing Steeds
page.objective: Find one of the horses that fled Wheeler's Grange after the coyote attack and give it some feed.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find one of the horses that fled Wheeler's Grange after the coyote attack and give it some feed. | Provided: | Wheeler's Steed Feed | Description | From what you found, it seems like the coyotes got most of the horses. Still, there's a few not accounted for. | Those that didn't get eaten probably ran off scared someplace. I don't know how many of those horses there are, but we'd better find 'em before the coyotes come back. | <Benjy holds out a sack in front of you.> | Here. If you find one, give it some of our feed. That'll get it to trust you so you can lead it back here.

page.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
page.objective: Report to Jezap at the Bloodmaster's Ring.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Report to Jezap at the Bloodmaster's Ring. | Description | You smashed weak Twilight ogres. But they weak. | Today you show Bloodmaster and little goblin friend you belong. | Tomorrow, maybe we meet again if you still breathing. | When you hand it in | Hey, hey! Look what we got here. Another victim...er entrant lookin' to prove themselves at the precipice of power! | Well step right up, bub. Today's your lucky day... or not.

page.name: Pay to Play
page.objective: Pay the safety deposit to qualify for the Bloodmaster's Ring.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Pay the safety deposit to qualify for the Bloodmaster's Ring. | Required money: 1 | Description | First things first. I'm gonna need a deposit for your, uh... safety. | Look, I don't make the rules here. It's required. | Now if you should choose not to pay I'll be forced to tell old Clugfist our new friend wasn't so keen on proving their strength to our warm, welcoming friends here. | That would be a real shame. Catch my drift, bub? | Rewards | Experience: | 330 | +10 reputation with Bolder'ok Clan | When you come back | So, what'll it be? | When you hand it in | A very wise choice.

page.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
page.objective: Defeat Buzzbeak in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Buzzbeak in the Bloodmaster's Ring. | Buzzbeak defeated | Description | The battle of the Bloodmaster's Ring begins! | We'll start you off easy here, pal. This flighty fiend'll take you down, then pick ya clean. | Now quit standin' around and step into the ring. Fame awaits! | When you hand it in | See? What'd I tell ya. Ain't nothin' to worry about here.

page.name: Encroaching Twilight
page.objective: Defeat 8 Twilight Raiders and 8 Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat 8 Twilight Raiders and 8 Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar. | Twilight Raider slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Shadowmancer slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Neophyte slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | Humans are not our only adversary within the Riverglades, â€¹nameâ€º, nor are they our most dire. | A cult known as the Twilight's Hammer has begun a campaign against those they deem heretics in the eyes of their twisted gods. The ravaged remains of a human settlement to the west are but the first to fall to their conquest. No doubt Rog'mar will be next. | We cannot afford to let them establish a foothold so close to our doorstep. Go to this so-called Sunnyglade and thin their numbers. | Rewards | Money: | 55 | 0 gold, 55 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,300 | When you hand it in | Excellent work, â€¹nameâ€º. With their numbers diminished, we can seek the source of the Twilight Hammer's unprecedented expansion.

page.name: Gnoll Infestation
page.objective: Kill 8 Redridge Mystics, 8 Redridge Trappers, and 6 Redridge Brutes for Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 8 Redridge Mystics, 8 Redridge Trappers, and 6 Redridge Brutes for Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch. | Redridge Mystic slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Redridge Trapper slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Redridge Brute slain | : | 0/ | 6 | Description | The gnolls have been a thorn in our side ever since we arrived. While less a threat than the Twilight's Hammer, they are aggressive, persistent and, worst of all, numerous. | The hills beyond this post are infested with them, making passage to the north dangerous, and posing a threat to those living outside the walls of Farholde Keep. | If we are ever to make these lands safe, removing the gnoll threat is imperative.

page.name: Snargl's Snout
page.objective: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch. | Snargl's Snout | Description | Gnolls value strength above all else. By killing their strongest, we not only lessen the threat they pose physically, but also strike fear into their hearts. | In a den among the Bristle Hills is a notorious gnoll by the name of Snargl. His death would no doubt sow panic among the Redridge's ranks. | Bring me his snout, and be quick about it. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Gnollhide Tunic | Southern Watch Leggings | Unbalanced Fighting Stick | Bristle Hills Mystic Robe | Experience: | 3,150 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Twilight Missives
page.objective: Retrieve 3 Twilight Missives from Twilight Shadowmancers in Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Retrieve 3 Twilight Missives from Twilight Shadowmancers in Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar. | 3 | Twilight Missive | Description | There have always been small pockets of Twilight's Hammer cultists here and there, but never have I seen them in such numbers. They seem emboldened by someone, or something, to expand their influence. | I would know more of these cultists and what they seek. Their shadowmancers are blessed by the dark powers and are likely the most trusted within their order to lead attacks of this scale. | Bring me anything you find off their corpses that we may glean knowledge into their campaign. | When you come back | Slay the Twilight Shadowmancers and search their corpses. With luck, they will have the information we seek. | When you hand it in | These missives tell of disturbing news, â€¹nameâ€º. These are no mere stragglers aimlessly biting at our heels like rabid animals. The Twilight's Hammer is here for a reason. They are searching for something.

page.name: Digging for Answers
page.objective: Convince a Twilight's Hammer miner in Sunnyglade to divulge their secrets.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Convince a Twilight's Hammer miner in Sunnyglade to divulge their secrets. | Twilight miner convinced | Description | The Twilight's Hammer are here for more than simple chaos, â€¹nameâ€º. They appear to be digging throughout the Riverglades for something. As for what they are searching for, I cannot say. A source of power, of course, but what that is still eludes me. | Their zealots may not be willing to divulge their secrets, but they must have someone doing the digging for them. These are the ones you are to question. Return to Sunnyglade and 'convince' one of their miners to talk. We must get to the bottom of this.

page.name: Our Ogre Friend
page.objective: Locate Gobam in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Locate Gobam in Bolder'ok. | Description | Alright, so you won a few battles. I think you might have what it takes to make it here after all. | Before I convince our next combatant to jump into the ring with you there's something I need from you first--food for Chub'chob's pet boar, Snufflesnout. | I promised I'd look after it, and, well, this gig here's keepin' me quite busy. Trust me, this'll benefit the both of us. | Mosey on over to the east of Clugfist's clubhouse. You're lookin' for a shy fella who goes by the name Gobam. | When you hand it in | Goblin sent you? Me no like little goblin. He talk too much. | But me help Chub'chob. He good friend.

page.name: A Boar's Delight
page.objective: Gather 8 Sweetberry and 12 Riverweed for Gobam.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 8 Sweetberry and 12 Riverweed for Gobam. | 8 | Sweetberry | 12 | Riverweed | Description | Gobam know Chub'chob pet love to eat food. Specially good food! | Yum yum berry and plant from river make good treat for Snufflesnout. Berry sweet. Best berry from human farm near ocean. | You find. Bring back. Me help make big treat. | When you come back | You get food? | When you hand it in | You make good work. | Berry smell yum yum good.

page.name: A Treat for a Friend
page.objective: Deliver the bundle of goods to Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the bundle of goods to Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok. | Treat for Snufflesnout | Description | Ok friend. Here is treat. Snufflesnout snort and be happy when she see this. | And tell goblin please stop talk so much. | When you hand it in | He said that? About me? Eh, no matter. | It's time we focus on what's really important--keepin' ol' Snufflesnout happy, and by Snufflesnout, I mean Chub'chob.

page.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
page.objective: Defeat Kronk in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Kronk in the Bloodmaster's Ring. | Kronk defeated | Description | Glad you made it through the first round, I guess. | This next contestant and I go way back. He ain't the brightest fella, but he's sure good at pummeling anything in his path. | Just head on into the pit and get yourself ready while I make the announcement. | When you hand it in | Hey, hey. Quiet down. I get the excitement, but that ain't no reason to rub it in.

page.name: The Wayward Warrior
page.objective: Find Da'grosh in the hills west of Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Da'grosh in the hills west of Rog'mar. | Description | You did well slowing the Twilight's Hammer. Their foothold in Sunnyglade has weakened and you've turned their ogre warriors against them. Now we take the fight to them. | My brother, Dag'rosh, has already gone ahead with a scouting party. I would have preferred he waited for you, but he is impulsive and overeager--like a true warrior. I'd be honored if you joined him in battle at their stronghold to the west. | When you hand it in | Krom'rosh sent you? He's more overbearing than a milk-toothed swineherd. | Not that I'll deny the extra muscle.

page.name: Carving a Path
page.objective: Defeat 8 Twilight Fanatics, 8 Twilight Corrupters, and 8 Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat 8 Twilight Fanatics, 8 Twilight Corrupters, and 8 Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh. | Twilight Fanatic slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Corrupter slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Champion slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | Do you see the fortress just west of here? The Twilight's Shroud, they call it. Filled to the brim with Twilight's Hammer cowards. | They may have walls and numbers, but their pitiful reliance on devilry and ancient gods makes them weak. Show them how vulnerable they really are! | Rewards | Money: | 65 | 0 gold, 65 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,750 | When you hand it in | Listen to them scream for their gods with no answer. The only true strength is within one's own hands!

page.name: Break Their Chains
page.objective: Rescue 5 Rog'mar Scouts within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Rescue 5 Rog'mar Scouts within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh. | Rog'mar Scout rescued | : | 0/ | 5 | 5 | Twilight Key | Description | Those Twilight's Hammer dogs caught us before we could properly begin our attack. I was able to fight my way out, but my warriors were not so lucky. They were dragged off by the cult's champions and imprisoned in the fortress to the west. | Orcs do not belong in cages, â€¹classâ€º. Free my brothers and sisters, and we will show these mongrels a real fight. | When you hand it in | Good work, priest. | My warriors are in no condition to fight and have returned to Rog'mar. But you and I are not done here yet.

page.name: Bring Me His Head
page.objective: Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Da'grosh.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Da'grosh. | Kilgar's Head | Description | Tran'gul's notes pointed to a leader of this Twilight's Hammer presence somewhere in that fortress. With my warriors free and the cult's numbers in disarray, now is the time to pierce the heart of this infestation. | Return to the Twilight's Shroud and enter their Stronghold. That is where you will find Overlord Kilgar. That is where we will exact our revenge. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Cloak of the Cult | Twilight Barrier | Experience: | 5,050 | When you come back | The coward is sure to be hiding deep within his stronghold. Bring me his head that we may put an end to this blight. | When you hand it in | I would have loved to see the look on Kilgar's face when you showed him just how exposed he truly was. | And now I can. | <Da'grosh laughs as he tosses Kilgar's head into the dirt.>

page.name: What We Lost
page.objective: Collect 5 Farmers' Mementos from Twilight Raiders and place them on the graves west of Elbrim's Farm.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 5 Farmers' Mementos from Twilight Raiders and place them on the graves west of Elbrim's Farm. | 5 | Farmers' Mementos | Mementos buried | : | 0/ | 5 | Description | If you've come to demand more of our crop, you're too late. No doubt you saw my farm. Destroyed. All of it. | Good folk toiled in these fields for years to feed troops and civilians alike. But when those cultists arrived, where was the military? Where was our promised protection after all the rations they'd taken from us? | If you've any sense of decency, I beg you. The least we can do is recover their belongings from those cursed raiders. Let my people rest with their kin in the graveyard to the west.

page.name: Unsavory Plant Food
page.objective: Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner. | 4 | Jumbo Crawfish Shell | 4 | Fresh Manure | 8 | Mudfin Murloc Head | Description | We make our own fertilizer out here. It's a special formula of mine that reeks like hell, but grows trees like they're weeds. | It's a 1:1:2 ratio of crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. Tasty, right? | The manure's easy enough. We've got the ranch to the south for that. The heads and shells? Those you're going to have to go wading in the river for. | If you feel like lending a hand, we could sure use your help getting some fertilizer ingredients. | Rewards | Money: | 20 | 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 2,850 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: From Seed to Sprout
page.objective: Plant 5 saplings around the lumber camp with Halligan Turner's tree sprouting kit.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Plant 5 saplings around the lumber camp with Halligan Turner's tree sprouting kit. | Sapling planted | : | 0/ | 5 | Provided: | Tree Sprouting Kit | Description | Considering you got yourself wrist-deep in guts and manure for us, it's only right you get to do the fun part too. | The boys and I gather seeds from the trees as we work. With the fertilizer you've provided, I've made a planting kit to put them in the ground to grow new saplings. | Take it, and find some good planting spots around the work sites.

candidates.name: If a Tree Falls, and No One Hears...

page.name: If a Tree Falls, and No One Hears...
page.objective: Go to Turner's Logging Camp and get help.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Go to Turner's Logging Camp and get help. | Description | Stranger, listen to me! | I work as a lumberjack for the nearby logging camp. As you can see, I've been trapped here in an accident. If I don't get out from here soon, I'll either bleed out, or be eaten by wild animals. | Please, go to the logging camp and fetch help! | When you hand it in | My brother's where?!

page.name: All That's Left
page.objective: Find Farmer Elbrim's family's possessions in the nearby barn and return them to him.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Farmer Elbrim's family's possessions in the nearby barn and return them to him. | Discarded Doll | Damaged Locket | Description | There was one more thing I wanted to talk to you about, friend. | When the Twilight's Hammer attacked, I put everyone who couldn't defend themselves in the barn to hide. I thought they would be safe. I thought... | <Elbrim's voice cracks as he recounts what happened.> | If you could do me one last kindness, will you go see what's left of my family? They should be buried here at home with me. I just don't have the heart to check myself.

page.name: Helping Hands
page.objective: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
requirements: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Go with Hurley to save Curly. | Go with Hurley to save Curly. | Description | Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year. | Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Curly's Chopper | Hurley's Felling Axe | Experience: | 3,000 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse | When you hand it in | That damn kid... | Even if he is a knucklehead, Curly's a good worker. Hopefully he heals up fine and learns some sense. Things could've gone a lot worse if you hadn't been there. Thanks for looking out for him.

page.name: Saving Sunnyglade
page.objective: Defeat 8 Twilight Raiders, 8 Twilight Shadowmancers, and 8 Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Demar Brant.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat 8 Twilight Raiders, 8 Twilight Shadowmancers, and 8 Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Demar Brant. | Twilight Raider slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Shadowmancer slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Neophyte slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | When you look around you, what do you see? A broken home and a tired people. | Stormwind has left us to fend for ourselves, and we have less to do that with every day. Many within these walls are refugees who barely escaped tragedy without so much as even their own families. | Farholde is no Stormwind, stranger. We lost a settlement in the northwest to the Twilight's Hammer, but we will not let them keep it. If you wish to fight, go to Sunnyglade and purge those savages from our lands. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Neophyte's Wand | Twilight Carver | Experience: | 3,150 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Scraps of Knowledge
page.objective: Collect 5 Twilight Pages from within Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberall in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 5 Twilight Pages from within Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberall in Farholde Keep. | 5 | Twilight Page | Description | You've seen the ruined city to the north, yes? Sunnyglade? Demar tries sending troops, but we're no closer to reclaiming it. I have a better idea. | In truth, this attack by the Twilight's Hammer is not the first. They seem to be coordinating from a centralized location, and I would know where. While you're out doing what you adventurers do best, see if you can't keep an eye out for any documents they may have misplaced. With enough of them, I should be able to piece together their intentions.

page.name: Curious Trinkets
page.objective: Retrieve 25 Twilight Charms from Twilight Shadowmancers and Twilight Neophytes in Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Retrieve 25 Twilight Charms from Twilight Shadowmancers and Twilight Neophytes in Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep. | 25 | Twilight Charm | Description | My, what have we here? A brave new â€¹classâ€º come to save us from our woes? How charming! Maybe you can help me with something then? I'd quite like to learn more about this cult in Sunnyglade. | Like any cult, they operate in a caste system. Those with an affinity for magic are often in high favor and are given tokens to demonstrate such. These charms are then imbued, and thus have a rich abundance of cultist magic. | I wish to see these tokens for myself. Be a dear and see if you can bring me a few, hmm?

page.name: An Unsettling Discovery
page.objective: Bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep. | Provided: | Filled Crystal Catalyst | Description | I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos. | I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest. | When you come back | You look like you found something extra delicious. Come come, show me what you have. | When you hand it in | You found Claire, did you? How lovely. | Her instincts were correct, I'm glad you brought this to me. I guess the Twilight's Hammer didn't expect such a direct response. I'll have to thank them later for supplying these marvelous reagents.

page.name: Field Marshal's Log
page.objective: Deliver the Field Marshal's Log to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the Field Marshal's Log to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep. | Field Marshal's Log | Description | The log is full of meticulous recordings on the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades. | The author is nowhere to be found, but this information could help shed light on enemy movements. | Someone in Farholde will want to see this. | Rewards | Money: | 25 | 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,150

page.name: The Western Front
page.objective: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west. | Description | As helpful as you've been here in Farholde, I believe your talents could be put to better use elsewhere. | A patrol of ours went missing some time ago. They were in charge of our western borders, but with the information Miss Amberhall has uncovered, I fear they walked right into the Twilight Hammer's central encampment. | We can handle the cleanup in Sunnyglade ourselves. If the good lady is right, it's critical that we check on our wayward sergeant. He could use all the help he can get.

page.name: Saving Marshal Ryan
page.objective: Find Marshal Ryan within the Twilight's Shroud.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Marshal Ryan within the Twilight's Shroud. | Marshal Ryan found | Description | Field Marshal Ryan is one of our best. His keen eyes and reliable intel have been paramount to our war efforts. | His final reports refer to a Twilight's Hammer fortress to the west. Find him before it's too late. And take his logbook with you. It may offer more clues as to the whereabouts of our missing marshal.

page.name: No Soldier Left Behind
page.objective: Rescue 5 Farholde Scouts within the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Rescue 5 Farholde Scouts within the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan. | Farholde Scouts rescued | : | 0/ | 5 | 5 | Twilight Key | Description | If Amberhall is so impatient for her report, it would have been nice if she sent more than one â€¹classâ€º. Must be hard work hiding in her ivory tower. | Look, every attempt to contact Farholde Keep ends with our runners being captured by Twilight scouts. I can't afford to risk any more troops going into that fortress, but we can't keep my people imprisoned in there either. | You want us to return? Help me rescue my soldiers first. You should be able to find the keys to their cages off their champions' corpses.

page.name: Carving a Path
page.objective: Defeat 8 Twilight Fanatics, 8 Twilight Corrupters, and 8 Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat 8 Twilight Fanatics, 8 Twilight Corrupters, and 8 Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan. | Twilight Fanatic slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Corrupter slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Twilight Champion slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | It seems every day the Twilight's Hammer are drawing more into their order, while we haven't heard so much as a word from Stormwind. Sooner or later we'll be overrun. | I don't care what a bureaucrat like Amberhall says. I'm not abandoning this position while an army amasses in our own homeland. If we leave now, we'll only have to deal with these cultists again later. Only next time, on our doorstep. | If your orders are to babysit me anyway, at least make yourself useful and help me cull these zealots. | Rewards | Money: | 30 | 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,750 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Bring Me His Head
page.objective: Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Sergeant Riftan.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Sergeant Riftan. | Kilgar's Head | Description | With this kind of momentum, we can't stop now. The soldiers we rescued are itching to draw blood, and you've already proven yourself a capable battering ram. | Return to the Twilight's Shroud and finish what we've started. Their leader, an orc by the name of Overlord Kilgar, hides deep within his keep while his underlings are lost in their panic. | If we want to put an end to this, bring me the head of Kilgar. These gods-fearing cowards can't make a single decision on their own. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Twilight Overlord Drape | Farholde Bastion | Experience: | 5,050 | +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: News to Farholde
page.objective: Return to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Return to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep. | Provided: | Kilgar's Head | Description | Seems like things are quieting down around here for now, but I want to keep an eye out. You want to send Amberhall a report? Send her this. | <Sergeant Riftan tosses Kilgar's head back to you.> | That ought to shut her up. At least for a while. Good work out there. | Rewards | You will receive: | Farholde Keep Tabard | Experience: | 4,050 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Dying Wish
page.objective: Return Marshal Ryan's crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Return Marshal Ryan's crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep. | Provided: | Marshal Ryan's Crest | Description | It's too late for me, stranger. I'm not going to be making it out of this one. Take my crest to the Knight Commander. Warn him... | <Ryan's eyes begin to glaze over as he mumbles to himself.> | I'm sorry. I should have come home. Abigail...

page.name: Delivering Closure
page.objective: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Abigail Lawson in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Abigail Lawson in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City. | Provided: | Marshal Ryan's Crest | Description | So, his final thoughts were of Abigail? | I know this is not your business, friend, but I must ask you to deliver the news of the Marshal's passing on my behalf. Ryan's betrothed, Abigail Lawson, did not join us when we established Farholde Keep. The two of them apparently had a disagreement, and while I do not know the specifics, I do know that she now resides within Stormwind City. | Please take the Marshal's crest to Terry for me. I don't think my presence would be a welcome one. | Rewards | Money: | 70 | 0 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 4,200 | +100 reputation with Stormwind

page.name: The Twilight Threat
page.objective: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City. | Provided: | Kilgar's Head | Description | Lady Amberhall told me of your exploits with the Twilight's Hammer. I'm impressed. But concerned. | Farholde started its campaign originally to remove the Horde from our homeland. While that remains our primary goal, we cannot take this sudden surge in cultist activity lightly. If our pleas to Stormwind remain unheard, we will be overwhelmed as we face foes on two fronts alone. | With the evidence you carry, perhaps they can set aside their pride long enough to listen. At this point it's our only option.

page.name: A Small Favor
page.objective: Summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit within the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.
requirements: Twilight Thrall captured (1) Twilight Thrall [DNT] Kill Credit: Twilight Thrall
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit within the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone. | Twilight Thrall captured (1) Twilight Thrall [DNT] Kill Credit: Twilight Thrall | Twilight Thrall | [DNT] Kill Credit: Twilight Thrall | Provided: | Amberhall's Soulstone | Description | You've been such a good little â€¹classâ€º for me, I wonder if I could ask you to do one more small favor. | With the reagents you collected being so finely attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, they are perfect for a summoning ritual. However, we'll need to take them to the source of their power. | Should you happen upon a conduit while you're gallivanting about the Twilight's Shroud, see if you can't call upon one of the cult's thralls and capture it with this soulstone for me. For questioning, of course.

page.name: Hats Off
page.objective: Find Robbie's Hat somewhere along the river near the murlocs.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Robbie's Hat somewhere along the river near the murlocs. | Robbie's Hat | Description | <Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.> | Psst! Hey <mister/miss>, I need your help! | My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was! | It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself! | Rewards | Money: | 20 | 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 2,150 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Hunting the Hunters
page.objective: Kill 12 Rog'mar Poachers for Watcher Cornelius.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 12 Rog'mar Poachers for Watcher Cornelius. | Rog'mar Poacher slain | : | 0/ | 12 | Description | The orcish poachers are a bloodthirsty lot. They'll kill anything that moves--be it men, lions, or horses. They are a threat to all life in the Riverglades, and must be stopped. | They roam the plains in packs, like rabid animals. If you see any, put them down. | Rewards | Money: | 25 | 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,000 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: A Fur Trade
page.objective: Bring 8 Prized Lion Hides to Watcher Terral.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 8 Prized Lion Hides to Watcher Terral. | 8 | Prized Lion Hide | Description | Farholde prides itself on its independence, but there are a few things we can only get through trade. | We've negotiated an arrangement with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. We provide her with goods that are dangerous to acquire, and she provides us with specialty munitions. | Currently, she's in the market for lion fur. A pride of them live atop a large hill in the center of the plains. If you'd like to make yourself useful, you could aid me in harvesting some of their hides.

page.name: Drop the Hammer
page.objective: Take Komuk's Maul to Farholde Keep as proof of the ogre's demise.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Take Komuk's Maul to Farholde Keep as proof of the ogre's demise. | Komuk's Warmaul | Description | Like most ogre weaponry, this hammer is large, unwieldy, and well-worn. A creature of any other race could hardly swing it at all. | To you, it is of little more use than a trophy, but perhaps someone at Farholde would appreciate knowing of Komuk's demise. | Rewards | You will receive: | Pauldron of Order | Experience: | 4,850 | +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Dunston Checks Out
page.objective: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok then return to Watcher Cornelius.
requirements: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok then return to Watcher Cornelius. | Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok | Description | When you're ready, I'll unlock my shackles, and we'll commence the escape. We'll take the quickest route, right through the center of camp. Be prepared for a fight. | Once we're out, I'll return to Farholde for medical treatment. As a final favor, I ask that you update Cornelius on my whereabouts. Frankly, the last thing I want after all this is to get an earful from that man. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Dunston's Ogre Duster | Bolder'ok Loincloth | Prisoner Handwraps | Experience: | 4,650 | +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: A Few Furs for Friz
page.objective: Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port. | Provided: | Bundle of Lion Pelts | Description | These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast. | When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for. | When you come back | Whaddya got for me? | When you hand it in | Cornelius ain't delivering these himself anymore? Thank goodness! Couldn't stand that guy. | <Friz inspects the contents of the bundle.> | Looks satisfactory. Tell your people at Farholde to keep 'em comin'.

page.name: Deliver the Second Shipment
page.objective: Bring the Shipment to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep in the Riverglades.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Shipment to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep in the Riverglades. | Provided: | Shipment to Farholde Keep | Description | I know I said that was it, but I promise, I wouldn't ask this if it weren't important. You should see Farholde along the eastern shore. | I thank you for your aid.

page.objective: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

page.name: Stolen Saws
page.objective: Recover 8 Saw Blades from the gnoll camps in Bristle Hills for Halligan Turner at the lumber mill.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Recover 8 Saw Blades from the gnoll camps in Bristle Hills for Halligan Turner at the lumber mill. | 8 | Saw Blade | Description | The boys up at Southern Watch do a good job keeping gnolls out for the most part. Every now and then a few sneak into the camp at night and cause a bit of trouble. They especially like to steal saw blades, which they likely use to make weapons out of the sharp metal. | If you could get some back for us, it'd be a big help. The gnolls have probably got 'em stashed away somewhere in their camps up in the hills to the west.

page.name: Biting the Hand
page.objective: Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle. | 20 | Twilight Finger Bone | Description | <The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.> | â€¹raceâ€º, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!

page.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
page.objective: Defeat Bonegnaw in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Bonegnaw in the Bloodmaster's Ring. | Bonegnaw defeated | Description | Alright, so you got a few wins under your belt. So what? | You're a long way from becoming the champ, bub. But I tell ya what--I'll make sure this next battle ain't one you'll soon forget. | Hope you're ready for a surprise. | When you hand it in | You sure ain't makin' me look good, pal. But I guess that doesn't matter much since our ogre friends here seem to be well entertained. | Don't let it go to your head.

page.name: Biting the Hand
page.objective: <Fuzzle snarls.>
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | <Fuzzle snarls.> | Fuzzle slain | Help Fuzzle escape Sunnyglade. | Description | Come, â€¹raceâ€º. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds! | Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward. | Rewards | Money: | 50 | 0 gold, 50 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,150

page.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
page.objective: Defeat Mog'thar in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Mog'thar in the Bloodmaster's Ring. | Mog'thar defeated | Description | Let's see if we can keep this crowd's excitement goin'. | This next contender ain't no joke. | Best of luck to ya! See you soon, maybe. | When you hand it in | Alright, big shot. Where the heck did you say you was from again? | You're startin' to make me look bad here.

page.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
page.objective: Defeat Snufflesnout in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Snufflesnout in the Bloodmaster's Ring. | Snufflesnout defeated | Description | Alright, so I'll place the treat and then you enter the ring and prepare for what's comin'. | What? Why you lookin' at me like that? I said we're gonna feed her. What I may have forgotten to mention was that ol' Snufflesnout gets pretty riled up at the sight of her favorite treat. | You're in a bit of a sticky situation here, bub. Proving yourself to our ogre friends is of the utmost importance, but boy oh boy would I be nervous inflicting harm to Chubchob's precious companion. | Well, off ya go! | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | 3 | Superior Healing Potion | 2 | Superior Mana Potion | Experience: | 4,650 | +150 reputation with Bolder'ok Clan | When you come back | So how'd it go? | When you hand it in | If I was you I'd watch yer step around here. You may have made a bit of a mess by defeating Chub'chob's friend.

We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else. | With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. page.objective: Bring the Satchel of Mementos to Melanie Sable.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Satchel of Mementos to Melanie Sable. | Satchel of Mementos | Description | Quite simple to dispel, really. Remnants of something, that's for sure. What, exactly, I do not know. | Well, I'm afraid I've done all that I can. I'm sorry if you were expecting more from me, but... on second thought, the craftsmanship of these is quite unique. Perhaps they could be of some use. | Take these to Melanie Sable. Tell her I sent you. page.name: Eyes for the Watchman
page.objective: Deliver Eleanor's care package to Watcher Fredericks at Southern Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Eleanor's care package to Watcher Fredericks at Southern Watch. | Provided: | Care Package | Description | Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. | I was just putting together a little something for a friend of mine. Well... more of an acquaintance, really. Have you met Watcher Fredericks yet? He's stationed at Southern Watch just west of here. | He comes by the ranch on patrol every now and then. I thought it would be nice to give him a little something to show my appreciation. | I'd deliver it myself, but I need to keep an eye on my little brother and tend to the ranch. | I'm sure you understand.

page.name: On the Other Side
page.objective: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas. | Description | If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too. | If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas. | Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.

page.name: Frazzlespark's Crate
page.objective: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep. | Frazzlespark's Crate | Description | Time for a special delivery. | Knight Commander Demar Brant at Farholde is waiting for this. For some reason he always makes me say his full name. What an odd fella. | Anywho, you can find him holed up in the keep southwest of here. Massive stone fortress. Ya can't miss it.

page.name: Frazzlespark's Crate
page.objective: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar. | Frazzlespark's Crate | Description | Time for a special delivery. | Old Krom'rosh is waiting for this package over at Rog'mar just west of here. | I suggest you get it to him quickly, but carefully. Why, you might ask? It's better to not ask questions. | When you hand it in | We've forged many relationships out of respect, others out of necessity. | These dealings help us accomplish our goals.

page.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
page.objective: Defeat Chub'chob, Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, in the Bloodmaster's Ring, then share the news of becoming the newly crowned champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring with Clugfist at Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat Chub'chob, Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, in the Bloodmaster's Ring, then share the news of becoming the newly crowned champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring with Clugfist at Bolder'ok. | Chub'chob defeated | Description | Ok, listen up. You've showed quite a bit of prowess in the ring. You've managed to upset Chub'chob more than words can explain. Sure glad I ain't you right now. | Just in case you was wonderin', I should remind you that your entry fee does not cover accidental death. | It's been great knowin' ya, but you're on your own from here on out, bub. | Best of luck to ya. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Bloodmaster's Ring | Bloodsport Band | Ogre Horn Ring | Money: | 1 | 30 | 1 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 4,850 | +1,500 reputation with Bolder'ok Clan | When you hand it in | Tiny thing show power in arena. Bring cheers from ogres. | Victory brings new friend to clan. You fight and feast with ogres now.

page.name: Preventative Measures
page.objective: Kill 12 Rog'mar Trainees for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.

page.name: The Rog'mar Situation
page.objective: Deliver the report to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.

page.name: Saltwater Savages
page.objective: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore. | Murloc Warrior slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Murloc Oracle slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here! | Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time. | Rewards | Money: | 40 | 0 gold, 40 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,300 | +100 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: Unfriendly Competition
page.objective: Kill 10 Eastsea Buccaneers and 10 Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 10 Eastsea Buccaneers and 10 Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port. | Eastsea Buccaneer slain | : | 0/ | 10 | Eastsea Musketeer slain | : | 0/ | 10 | Description | You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port". | They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks! | We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north. | Rewards | Money: | 60 | 0 gold, 60 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,600 | +100 reputation with Powderfuse

An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands. | A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise. | Rewards | You will receive: | Rot-Covered Harpoon | Money: | 30 | 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 4,300 | +150 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: A Taste of the Sea
page.objective: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz. | 12 | Saltwater Murloc Eye | 6 | Sand Crawler Meat | Description | Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day... | This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do. | You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients! | Rewards | You will receive: | Recipe: Briny Seafood Stew | Experience: | 3,150 | +100 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: Unchecked Expansion
page.objective: Kill 8 Eastsea Raiders and 8 Eastsea Bombardiers for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 8 Eastsea Raiders and 8 Eastsea Bombardiers for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz. | Eastsea Raider slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Eastsea Bombardier slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | Those Eastsea pirates you whacked, while dangerous, were just the small fries. They've got bigger, badder brothers in arms north of here. They ransacked Windstead--took all the plunder they could, then burned it to the ground. | They've gotta be stopped before their turf gets any farther inland. Thin out their ranks so that doesn't happen. | Rewards | Money: | 30 | 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,750 | +100 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: A Blast Ye Scurvy Dogs!
page.objective: Steal 5 Eastsea Powder Kegs for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Steal 5 Eastsea Powder Kegs for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz. | 5 | Eastsea Powder Keg | Description | As much as I love seeing Eastsea heads roll, we also gotta take out their ships. Can't have 'em running off for reinforcements, now can we? | I've got a plan for that, but we're gonna need some gunpowder. A LOT of it. | The pirates are probably storing some near the freshly-demolished Winstead to the north. See if you can get your hands on it. I'll fill you in on the rest later.

page.name: Admiral Lamora
page.objective: Slay Admiral Lamora, locate his stash of loot, and return it to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Slay Admiral Lamora, locate his stash of loot, and return it to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz. | Admiral Lamora slain | Lamora's Loot | Description | Now it's time to go after the big man himself: Admiral Lamora. Obviously, I want him dead, but I need a little something extra from him too. | Seeing how all his plundering has been costing me a fortune, I figure it's only right that I recoup some losses. | Lamora's on one of the Eastsea's boats northeast of here. Find out which and where on it he's keeping his loot. Bring me whatever he's got. If it's locked up, he's likely got the key on him. | Rewards | Money: | 65 | 0 gold, 65 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,900 | +150 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: Report to Rog'mar
page.objective: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades. | Description | Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades. | Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains. | As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.

page.name: Finding Tan'jani
page.objective: Find Tan'jani at Rog'mar in the Riverglades.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Tan'jani at Rog'mar in the Riverglades. | Description | I've been watching you, â€¹nameâ€º. You handle yourself well out here. Perhaps you'd be interested in helping me locate my brother, Tan'jani. | He was always searching for something--for what I do not know. I received two messages since he left. The first from another traveler, letting me know he'd run into Tan'jani somewhere south of Loch Modan. The second was a bloodstained letter mentioning Riverglades and somewhere called Rog'mar, even further south. The rest was illegible. | Think you can locate him for me?

page.name: Overseas Delivery
page.objective: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades. | Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate | Description | Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do-- | DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE! | Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements. | I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage. | Best of luck to ya!

page.name: The Lost Scout
page.objective: Deliver Bolain's message to Captain Dalton at Southern Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Bolain's message to Captain Dalton at Southern Watch. | Crudely Fashioned Report | Description | You... where did you come from? You shouldn't be here! | <Bolain struggles through the pain--bruised, battered, and a disease-ridden bite wound to his leg.> | Take this to Dalton. Head north up the road and east where the plains open wider than this gash in my damn leg. I'd tell you to tell him he was right, but I won't give him that satisfaction... at least not until after I'm dead. | I hate these damn hills!

page.name: Southern Watch Gnoll Report
page.objective: Deliver the Southern Watch Gnoll Report to the knight commander at Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the Southern Watch Gnoll Report to the knight commander at Farholde Keep. | Southern Watch Gnoll Report | Description | As much as I'd like to deliver the blood-soaked message to the knight commander himself, I'd also like to keep my post. I've cleaned it up a bit so it's less... well, bloody. | Given the recent gnoll uprisings, I'm afraid the task of delivering the news falls upon you.

page.name: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em
page.objective: Collect 3 Bundles of Hay for Ember at the training grounds.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 3 Bundles of Hay for Ember at the training grounds. | 3 | Bundle of Hay | Description | Our training dummies are starting to show significant wear and tear. If we don't fix them up soon I worry our recruits may be unprepared for battle. | If you hadn't seen it on your way in, there's a small farmstead just outside the keep run by a man by the name of Wheeler. He may have a few extra bushels of hay he'd be willing to part with. | I'll see to it he's compensated if he's able to spare supplies for our efforts.

page.name: Remember That I Love You
page.objective: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood. | Provided: | Blood-Stained Letter | Description | If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage. | If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you? | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Tarnished Locket | Experience: | 180 | When you come back | Yes? What do you need? | When you hand it in | Oh no... | It's nice of you to bring this, but I don't think Jeremy is ready to see it. Matron Nightingale said my little Jeremy hasn't spoken since the attack on Lordaeron, and I don't intend to force him now. Showing him this will only cause him more pain. | Don't look at me like that. I won't hide his past from him, but he needs time to heal. I'll give this to him when he's older. Thank you for stopping by, but I think it's time you should go.

page.name: Paletusk Harvesting
page.objective: Gather 10 Chunks of Boar Meat for Na'zok near Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 10 Chunks of Boar Meat for Na'zok near Bolder'ok. | 10 | Chunk of Boar Meat | Description | With so little land not claimed by the humans or Twilight's Hammer, this ranch is one of our very few sources of food. Ogres aren't much in the way of farmers, but they love a good paletusk roast, and have agreed to let me stay so long as the meat keeps coming. | As our war advances, the demand for food is only ever increasing. Now I hardly have enough food to keep these ogres from looking at me like I'm their next meal. | If we want to have enough meat for Rog'mar, I'll need your help with the harvest. | Rewards | You will receive: | Recipe: Plain Ol' Paletusk | Experience: | 3,300 | When you come back | Don't bother with the little ones. There's not enough meat on them yet to satisfy an ogre. | Hurry, rogue. They're starting to look hungry. | When you hand it in | Not bad. This should be enough to keep the ogres happy and still have plenty left for Rog'mar.

page.name: Drive Them Back
page.objective: Return 10 Young Paletusks to Na'zok's farm near Bolder'ok.
requirements: Young Paletusk returned (10) Young Paletusk [DNT] Kill Credit Young Paletusk
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Return 10 Young Paletusks to Na'zok's farm near Bolder'ok. | Young Paletusk returned (10) Young Paletusk [DNT] Kill Credit Young Paletusk | Young Paletusk | [DNT] Kill Credit Young Paletusk | Provided: | Swineherd's Staff | Description | As you can see, there are more pigs strewn about the valley than there are in their pens. Gorgegut has been less than an ideal farmhand, but he keeps the humans away. | Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens. | When you hand it in | That should be the last of them. I'll need to repair the gate, but a swift kick in the rear will convince those little piglets not to go running off again.

page.name: See Ya, Scallywags!
page.objective: Plant a remote explosive charge on each of the Eastsea's three boats.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Plant a remote explosive charge on each of the Eastsea's three boats. | First Ship Charge planted | Second Ship Charge planted | Third Ship Charge planted | Provided: | Remote Explosive Charge | Description | So, here's how we're gonna sink those ships. | I can use that gunpowder you stole and make timed charges. All you've gotta do is hop on each of the Eastsea's boats, and plant one charge in the hull of each. Look for a spot near their cannons, that gunpowder'll make our explosives even more powerful. Once the charges are set, get outta there, and I'll hit the detonator! | The elegance of the plan is in its simplicity, don't ya think?

page.name: Step One: Rock
page.objective: Gather 10 Good Rocks for Hamur in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 10 Good Rocks for Hamur in Bolder'ok. | 10 | Good Rock | Description | You want ogre weapon? Me know no. You small. Can't hold good. | You bring Hamur more rocks, me make you tiny weapon. Good for tiny creature. | Find good rocks for good weapon. Hamur has discerning eye. Not just any rock will do. Find rocks near river outside Bolder'ok. | When you come back | Not all rocks equal. Some good. Some gooder. | When you hand it in | These good rocks! Hamur make tiny creature tiny weapon.

page.name: The Sharpest of Blades
page.objective: Bring 8 Solid Sharpening Stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 8 Solid Sharpening Stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds. | 8 | Solid Sharpening Stone | Description | The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran. | I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death. | If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there. | Rewards | Money: | 20 | 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 2,850 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse
