page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the Cask of Powderfuse Port to Mardrack Greenwell at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. | Cask of Powderfuse Port | Description | Got another job for ya, kiddo. How do you feel about traveling the world? | This here is some of the finest port you ever laid eyes on. Trouble is, it's gotta go quite the distance to one of my customers all the way over to Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. When you've reached trees taller than you've ever seen before, you know you've reached the spot. | One of my guys packed it airtight but there's no telling what might set it off, so handle with care, okay bub?

page.name: WANTED: Trapclaw
page.objective: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz. | Trapclaw's Pincer | Description | Calling all anglers! | I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines. | I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up. | -- Fimbo Greasemitz | Rewards | You will receive: | 5 | Undermine Clam Chowder | Money: | 30 | 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,450 | +150 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: Terrors From the Deep
page.objective: Find someone at Powderfuse Port who can identify the monster from the painted hide.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find someone at Powderfuse Port who can identify the monster from the painted hide. | Description | The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be? | The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.

page.name: It Takes Guts
page.objective: Collect 15 Beast Entrails and 8 Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 15 Beast Entrails and 8 Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle. | 15 | Beast Entrails | 8 | Rotflesh Mushroom | Description | That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories! | We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait... | Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.

page.name: The Monster Surfaces
page.objective: Use the Big Ball o' Bait to lure out the sea monster. Then, bring its head to Argo Brinewhistle.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Use the Big Ball o' Bait to lure out the sea monster. Then, bring its head to Argo Brinewhistle. | Sea Monster's Head | Provided: | Big Ball o' Bait | Description | The last part's <hic> easy...just take that big ball 'a guts, aaand chuck it in the water! Er...not here though...that'd be a disaster. | Go to those <hic> murloc islands, where ya found the drawing. Look for fresh wreckage in the water. That's where you gotta throw the bait. | Soon as that thing sticks its head up, chop it off! We'll make a decoration of it...for the boat! | Rewards | You will receive: | Bottle of Powderfuse Port | Experience: | 3,450 | +150 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: It Is Time, Brother...
page.objective: Deliver the missive to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the missive to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar. | Blood and Battle | Description | The threat is greater than we thought. Rog'mar must be warned. | Do not stop for anyone on your path. | When you hand it in | As a child, Da'grosh would seek to inspire myself and the other kin of our village that some day we would all become great warriors of the Horde, saving our people from imminent danger. | Now, it appears that opportunity has come.

page.name: Smuggler's Paradise
page.objective: Collect 8 Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 8 Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port. | 8 | Smuggled Goods | Description | You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test. | Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first! | Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.

page.name: Smuggler's Special
page.objective: Deliver The Friz Special to Captain Bentcoin in Eastwind Shore.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver The Friz Special to Captain Bentcoin in Eastwind Shore. | Provided: | The Friz Special | Description | Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people. | Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.

page.name: Smuggler's Bargain
page.objective: Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port. | Description | Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day. | Run along back to your master, â€¹classâ€º. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.

page.name: I Know a Guy
page.objective: Speak to Friz's contact in Booty Bay.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak to Friz's contact in Booty Bay. | Description | Ya did good with those pirates, lackey. But here's a lesson for ya you may want to remember. What some may call a pirate, others call a freebooter. And you can't spell freebooter without free booty. And there's no better place for free booty than Booty Bay! | <Friz waits for your reply.> | Keep up with me here, kid. I'm sayin' I need you to go to Booty Bay to meet with my contact. He gets goods from the local pirates there-- err, freebooters. Look, just go find Ruzzgot. He'll explain the rest.

page.name: Shipping and Handling
page.objective: Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. | Required money: 10 | Provided: | Friz's Secret Stash | Description | Sounds like you're ready for your next lesson, champ. I got some negotiatin' of my own to do here in town, so I need you to run a few errands for me while I'm busy. | All I need you to do is take the next ship over there by the docks and deliver this crate to my associate in Steamwheedle Port. | Don't gimme that look. It'll be plenty excitin', I'm sure. Gettin' a goblin to pay his dues is much harder than roughin' up the local riffraff, not to mention gettin' through customs. You'll figure it out. | Rewards | Experience: | 320 | +10 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: Coming to Collect
page.objective: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan. | Description | I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan. | Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand <boy/girl>, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know. | Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.

candidates.name: The Riverglades Report
candidates.reason: Relevant introduction, local dungeon stage, or delivery to Riverglades

page.name: The Riverglades Report
page.objective: Deliver Captain Nials' Correspondence to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep along the southeastern coast in the Riverglades.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Captain Nials' Correspondence to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep along the southeastern coast in the Riverglades. | Captain Nials' Correspondence | Description | Word from one of our scouts suggests a large force of enemies amassing to the far, far south, well beyond the Wetlands. | Even more curious is there appears to be an alliance settlement out there. Farholde? The name sounds familiar. | Let's not wait on this. Best to begin the conversation before it's too late. We're dealing with enough here as it is. | Take this correspondence and deliver it to whoever claims to be the leader of this detachment.

page.name: Tazzik's Dues
page.objective: Confront Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Confront Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. | Tazzik confronted | Description | Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings? That's a joke, right? His slackjaw champion didn't even last two minutes in the arena! That loser didn't earn a single copper. | It's none of my business, pal, but if I were you I'd skedaddle back to Steamwheedle Port. While you're standin' here talkin' to me, that little rat Tazzik is probably tryin' to hop the next ship outta here. | When you hand it in | Okay you win! I bet everythin' I had on those fights to pay off Friz and I lost it all! | But I can't give back her stuff. You gotta help me out here!

page.name: Get the Goods
page.objective: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. | Bloodsail Trunk examined | Description | Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for. | But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course. | They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh? | When you hand it in | Venture Co? And the trunk was empty? | Those rotten cheats stole my money! I knew dealin' with those good-for-nothin' pirates was bad for business! Nobody goes back on a deal with Ruzzgot and gets away with it.

page.name: We've Been Robbed!
page.objective: Find the Venture Co. Ledger in the Venture Co. Camp near Lake Nezferiti in Stranglethorn.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find the Venture Co. Ledger in the Venture Co. Camp near Lake Nezferiti in Stranglethorn. | Description | I already spent good coin on that crate. We ain't just going to let them have it! | You want your shipment? Go to the Venture Co's camp up north and find out who's responsible for this backstabbin'! This ain't about money anymore, â€¹nameâ€º. This is about justice! And maybe a little about the money. | When you hand it in | <A grease covered tome filled with notes of business deals between the Venture Co. and its associates.>

page.name: The Big Payback
page.objective: Kill the Venture Co. Agent and take back Ruzzgot's Shipment for him in Booty Bay.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill the Venture Co. Agent and take back Ruzzgot's Shipment for him in Booty Bay. | Ruzzgot's Shipment | Description | <The ledger contains a log of each of Ruzzgot's deliveries. The final note marks the heist a success and Ruzzgot's valuables collected by a nearby Venture Co. agent. The goods must still be with him.> | When you come back | Well? You find out who took my stuff? | When you hand it in | That's more like it! If a caravaneer can't be trusted with a delivery, what else does he have? | Say, you don't need help shipping this to Powderfuse Port, do ya?

page.name: All's Well That Ends Well
page.objective: Return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades. | Provided: | Ruzzgot's Shipment | Description | Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself. | Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.

page.name: Out in the Field
page.objective: Go to Terral's Watch to get a status report from Watcher Cornelius.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Go to Terral's Watch to get a status report from Watcher Cornelius. | Description | There is a watch tower overlooking the plains to the north. It serves as an observation point to track any motion of the Horde's forces. | The watcher stationed there is named Cornelius. Speak to him and get a status report. He is all alone out there, so I like to check on him with some regularity. Fair warning, he can be a bit...taciturn. It's why he was assigned such a remote post in the first place.

page.name: Love Thy Neighbor
page.objective: Deliver Cassandra's surplus farm goods to Halligan Turner at Turner's Logging Camp.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Cassandra's surplus farm goods to Halligan Turner at Turner's Logging Camp. | Provided: | Surplus Crops | Description | My husband and I have a farm north of here. I come to Farholde after each harvest to sell what we grow. In good seasons, I like to set aside whatever we don't sell to give to folks who need a little pick-me-up. Gotta take care of your neighbors, I say. | There's a logging camp north of our farm, right on the river. I'm sure those boys could use some fruits and vegetables to give 'em some variety in their diet. | If you're heading that way, could you give this to the foreman there? Name's Halligan Turner.

page.name: Shipping and Handling
page.objective: Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port. | Provided: | Friz's Secret Stash | Description | <Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.> | Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, <sir/ma'am>. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that. | But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.

page.name: The Purple Ones
page.objective: Find missing ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade for Clubtoe.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find missing ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade for Clubtoe. | Description | Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more. | Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think. | You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too. | When you hand it in | <The ogre lies dead, surrounded by a ring of dark runes. It appears to have been overwhelmed by the powers of the Twilight Hammer's ritual.>

page.name: Spread the Word
page.objective: Deliver the head of Chogg to Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the head of Chogg to Tran'gul in Rog'mar. | Provided: | Chogg's Head | Description | Me done with Twilight. Clubtoe free ogre now. | Me go find Clugfist. He biggestest ogre Clubtoe ever see. He leave Twilight. Take many friends with him. It Clubtoe's turn. Me join free ogres. They go to the hills. Clubtoe miss hills. No more smashing rocks. Maybe you come sometime? | Me stay here till coast is clear. You take Chogg'Zac's heads back to friends. Well. Maybe one head. Me get one too. Fair trade. | When you come back | So, the Twilight's Hammer found something in the earth? You were right to banish this evil, â€¹nameâ€º. If it interests those fanatics, it's not to be trusted. | When you hand it in | Well, well. Looks like that cave was not our only surprise. | You managed to convince one of the Twilight's Hammer ogres to defect? And he mentioned others of his kind? We must act on this immediately.

page.name: Land of Giants
page.objective: Deliver Chogg's head to the ogre city to the north.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Chogg's head to the ogre city to the north. | Provided: | Chogg's Head | Description | Clearly these wayward ogres are no friends to the Twilight's Hammer. We orcs have an honored history fighting alongside ogres, and it may be time to call upon those old alliances again. And this head may be the key. | There have been reports of ogre activity in the hills far to the north. If this Clubtoe is to be believed, that must be where this clan calls home. Go to their stronghold and offer this trophy as a token of our friendship. With luck, they will listen to your proposal before they step on you. | When you come back | <The massive ogre belches in your face.> | What tiny creature bring Clugfist? | When you hand it in | You smash Chogg'Zac? Little thing shows power. | What you want with Clugfist?

page.name: Might Makes Right
page.objective: Kill 7 Twilight Maulers and 7 Twilight Firecallers for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 7 Twilight Maulers and 7 Twilight Firecallers for Clugfist in Bolder'ok. | Twilight Mauler slain | : | 0/ | 7 | Twilight Firecaller slain | : | 0/ | 7 | Description | Here ogres value strength and blood. | Weak ones leave Bolder'ok. Go back to Twilight's Hammer. | You no big. Maybe you strong. Show Clugfist strength and smash weak ogres. If tiny creature can. | Rewards | Money: | 55 | 0 gold, 55 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,300 | +100 reputation with Bolder'ok Clan | When you hand it in | Tiny undead show strength. Ground shook with dead Twilight. Me feel from here!

page.name: Unworthy Champion
page.objective: Collect Skullthumper from Klunk for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect Skullthumper from Klunk for Clugfist in Bolder'ok. | Skullbasher | Description | Klunk once Clugfist's greatest champion. Him strong. Me give Klunk mighty weapon. | But Clugfist wrong. Klunk weak like others. He leave Bolder'ok. Return to Twilight's Hammer. Take ogres with him to cave east to water. Take mighty weapon with him! | That Clugfist weapon! Bash Klunk's skull and take back Skullbasher. He nobody's champion! | When you come back | What you want? Bring Skullbasher now! | When you hand it in | Skullbasher belong to real ogre. Someday Clugfist pick new champion.

page.name: Rog'mar Supplies
page.objective: Retrieve 8 Horde Supply Shipment from the training camps north of Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Retrieve 8 Horde Supply Shipment from the training camps north of Rog'mar. | 8 | Rog'mar Supply Crate | Description | Supply delivery to this area is no easy feat. All sorts of unscrupulous characters surround us in all directions, each seeking their own piece of the pie. | Now, with that said, perhaps this is an opportunity to slow Rog'mar's growth. What do you say to throwing a little wrench in our orc friends' plans? | Head north of Rog'mar to their training grounds and steal their supply shipments. The recovery time alone ensures our forces remain battle ready while theirs... well, you see where this is going.

page.name: Twilight No More!
page.objective: Kill Chogg'Zac in the Sunnyglade cave and collect their heads for Clubtoe.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill Chogg'Zac in the Sunnyglade cave and collect their heads for Clubtoe. | Chogg's Head | Zac's Head | Description | Clubtoe friends... dead? Why? | This Chogg'Zac fault! Dey say they make ogres strong! They lie!! | No more smashing rocks! Tiny creature help Clubtoe smash Chogg'zac stupid heads instead! | Rewards | Money: | 25 | 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,300 | +100 reputation with Bolder'ok Clan | When you come back | No more kill friends! Chogg'Zac die today! | When you hand it in | Tiny undead kill Chogg'Zac? | <Clubtoe lets out a triumphant bellow that echoes through the caves.> | Clubtoe done smashing rock for tinies! Clubtoe done losing friends! Me Twilight no more!

page.name: Clugfist's Decree
page.objective: Report to Krom'rosh in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Report to Krom'rosh in Rog'mar. | Description | Little â€¹raceâ€º smash Twilight good. Maybe your Horde stronger than Clugfist think. | You free to stay in Bolder'ok. For now. | Tell other tinies we spill blood again soon. | When you hand it in | An ogre uprising? And so soon after their own battle for freedom from the Twilight's Hammer? These warriors have nearly as bloody a history as our own. They will make for powerful allies if we can continue to gain their trust. | You've done well, â€¹nameâ€º. I suspect this is only the beginning of our dealings with the Bolder'ok clan.

page.name: Rumblings of Discontent
page.objective: Look for the Bolder'ok ogre in the nearby cave.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Look for the Bolder'ok ogre in the nearby cave. | Description | As I've shadowed our enemy's movements, I have discovered a weakness among their ranks. Ogre dissidents have begun to rebel, seeking the same freedom as their Bolder'ok kin. Word of your deeds has spread. We must exploit this. | I spied a Bolder'ok warrior heading to the caves west of here in search of his brothers and sisters. Find him, and join his efforts to rally his people. | When you hand it in | <Crag'rog readies his mace to attack before he takes a closer look at you.> | Wait... Crag'rog know you. You fight for Clugfist!

page.name: Rise Up!
page.objective: Recruit 5 Ogre Miners.
requirements: Ogre Miners recruited (5) [DNT] Kill Credit: Ogre Miner Ogre Miner
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Recruit 5 Ogre Miners. | Ogre Miners recruited (5) [DNT] Kill Credit: Ogre Miner Ogre Miner | [DNT] Kill Credit: Ogre Miner | Ogre Miner | Description | When Crag'rog hear undead-ling free ogres, Crag'og want free ogres too. | With tiny â€¹classâ€º here, we smash Twilight together. Break them bones. Make them scream. Free ogres! Then be home in time for stew. | When you come back | Twilight think ogres dumb. Make them labor. Waste ogre potential. Kill any Twilight who stand in your way! | When you hand it in | We free many ogres. This good. We kill weak, coward ogres. That better. | Only one coward ogre left.

page.name: Death to the Executioner
page.objective: Collect the Executioner's Mace from Executioner Morg in the Twilight Shroud for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect the Executioner's Mace from Executioner Morg in the Twilight Shroud for Clugfist in Bolder'ok. | Executioner's Mace | Description | When Clugfist leave Twilight, one ogre stand in way. Morg. | Morg massive ogre. Nearly as massive as Clugfist. But not massivest. He need tinies to protect him. Clugfist never got fair fight. Now WE no fight fair. | Find Morg. Bring many tinies with you. Kill him. Take mace back to Clugfist. Then Twilight know they challenge us no more! | Rewards | You will receive: | Thud Hammer | Experience: | 5,050 | +150 reputation with Bolder'ok Clan | When you come back | Crag'rog say you join him in fight. What you bring mighty Clugfist? | When you hand it in | Morg is dead! Tiny undead full of tricks. Clugfist like you. | Twilight's Hammer crumple beneath might of Bolder'ok. We free ogres!

page.name: Consolation Prize
page.objective: Bring Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port. | Provided: | Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt | Description | I'm tellin' ya, I can't pay Friz back! I got nothin' left but the shirt off my back! | Why are you lookin' at me like that... | Rewards | You will receive: | Sweat-Stained Shirt | Experience: | 2,350 | +100 reputation with Powderfuse

page.name: Apple of My Eye
page.objective: Collect 6 Fresh Apples for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 6 Fresh Apples for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep. | 6 | Fresh Apple | Description | <The loud cries of baby Dawnbright echo through Farholde Keep. Tessa looks at you with a tired smile.> | Oh, hello there adventurer. Sorry for the noise. Little Emma here seems to be quite fussy today, but I'm not sure why. Maybe some food will help. | Do you think you could help me find something for her to eat? My husband stepped out to get some supplies so my hands are a little too full to get them myself. If you could find a few apples around here I could make a lovely mash for her. | Rewards | You will receive: | 5 | Goldenbark Apple | Experience: | 1,450 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Cut Off the Heads
page.objective: Kill Chogg'Zac in the caves beneath Sunnyglade and retrieve their heads for Apprentice Claire.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill Chogg'Zac in the caves beneath Sunnyglade and retrieve their heads for Apprentice Claire. | Chogg's Head | Zac's Head | Description | I have a confession to make. Lady Amberhall did send me to collect those samples, but in truth I volunteered. Sunnyglade was my home before the war took it from me, and I could not rest knowing monsters still taint it. Be it horde or Twilight. | There is no victory here by learning from them. There's nothing to learn. They're beasts, plain and simple, and should be put down like beasts. | We must slay their master at the bottom of this cave and bring an end to this. Surely my mistress will understand. | Rewards | Money: | 25 | 0 gold, 25 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,300 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse | When you come back | The ghosts of this village cry out for vengeance, â€¹nameâ€º. And we must give it to them. | When you hand it in | It's dead? You killed the ogres? | You've done the right thing, â€¹nameâ€º. Now let's get out of here.

page.name: The Purple Ones
page.objective: Kill 5 Empowered Brutes and 10 Twilight Ritualists then return to Clubtoe in Sunnyglade.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 5 Empowered Brutes and 10 Twilight Ritualists then return to Clubtoe in Sunnyglade. | Empowered Brute slain | : | 0/ | 5 | Twilight Ritualist slain | : | 0/ | 10 | Description | <This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more. | These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.> | When you hand it in | Tiny undead not turn purple! Hurray! | But... where friends?

page.name: Sickening Lights
page.objective: Destroy 5 Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Destroy 5 Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade. | Twilight Ritual Circle destroyed | : | 0/ | 5 | Description | Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid. | Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it. | Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should. | When you hand it in | Clubtoe feel better already! You smash lots of shiny pictures? Were others mad?

page.name: Bats in the Belfry
page.objective: Kill 5 Roosting Duskbats in the Farholde Cathedral for Sister Rowland.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 5 Roosting Duskbats in the Farholde Cathedral for Sister Rowland. | Roosting Duskbat slain | : | 0/ | 5 | Description | Since brother Lowley and I began serving Farholde in a more secular capacity, the church here has fallen into disuse. I'd like to think that once the fighting is over, we will be able to bring the Light back to this place. Although, I fear that may not be for a long while... | Still, we need to keep the church in working order, in the hope that day will come. | To that end, a colony of bats has taken to roosting in the upper stories of the church. It would be a great help if you could remove them.

page.name: Keeping the Light On
page.objective: Bring 5 Holy Candles to Sister Rowland in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 5 Holy Candles to Sister Rowland in Farholde Keep. | 5 | Holy Candle | Description | While we no longer hold service at the church, I feel it important to keep the candles lit on the graves of our fallen in the church's crypt. To me, keeping the candle's flame alive is a symbol that they are not forgotten and their sacrifices were not in vain. | If you would, bring me candles so that I might continue this ritual. It would mean a great deal to me. | If you're not sure where to find them, speak with Marla in the house just outside of the church. She's a friend and may have some to spare. | Rewards | Money: | 30 | 0 gold, 30 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 2,150 | +25 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: In Memoriam
page.objective: Place 3 Memorial Candles on graves in the chapel graveyard for Sister Rowland at Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Place 3 Memorial Candles on graves in the chapel graveyard for Sister Rowland at Farholde Keep. | Candles replaced | : | 0/ | 3 | Provided: | Bundle of Candles | Description | If you don't mind, I'd like you to do the honor of lighting these memorial candles. Go to the cemetery just outside and place a fresh candle wherever you see one that's gone out. | Such a task is a far cry from the excitement of your other adventures, I'm sure. Think of this as an opportunity for service and reflection--a quiet moment to acknowledge those who left this world before us, so that we might carry on and make it a better place. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Sacristan Band | Verger Greaves | You will also receive: | Warding Candle | Experience: | 2,150 | +50 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Abominable Magics
page.objective: Absorb 25 samples into the Crystal Catalyst from Twilight's Hammer cultists and Twilight Ritual Circles in the cave underneath Sunnyglade for Apprentice Claire.
requirements: Crystal Catalyst filled (25) Empowered Brute Twilight Ritual Circle Twilight Ritualist
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Absorb 25 samples into the Crystal Catalyst from Twilight's Hammer cultists and Twilight Ritual Circles in the cave underneath Sunnyglade for Apprentice Claire. | Crystal Catalyst filled (25) Empowered Brute Twilight Ritual Circle Twilight Ritualist | Empowered Brute | Twilight Ritual Circle | Twilight Ritualist | Provided: | Crystal Catalyst | Description | You there! Thank the light you've come. Did Amberhall send you to find me? | No? Figures as much. Ashe Amberhall sent me down here to investigate the Twilight's Hammer. As you can see, they are digging for something within the Riverglades, but I need a sample of their witchcraft to figure out what. | It's imperative Farholde gets those samples. Please, â€¹classâ€º. Take this catalyst. It's enchanted to absorb the powers of the cult. Runes, cultists, it doesn't matter. Just hold it aloft and it will do the rest. | When you come back | Be careful around the big ones. They may seem simple, but they are powerful sorcerers in their own right. | When you hand it in | <Claire flinches as she touches the crystal crackling with cultist magic.> | This is more potent than I ever feared. We'll need to handle this with care.

page.name: Indiscriminate Purge
page.objective: Kill 5 Twilight Ritualists and 5 Empowered Brutes within the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 5 Twilight Ritualists and 5 Empowered Brutes within the caves underneath Sunnyglade. | Empowered Brute slain | : | 0/ | 5 | Twilight Ritualist slain | : | 0/ | 5 | Description | As Lady Amberhall's apprentice in the dark arts, I may not look it but I'm usually quite capable of handling things on my own. I did not, however, anticipate an entire cave of void-infused ogres. | If you managed to get all the way down here without being captured, you must be powerful yourself. I was not so lucky with those ogres and their masters roaming about. Do the world a favor and kill the hideous beasts. Nothing good comes from a fanatic with a purpose, empowered or otherwise. | When you hand it in | You managed to put down a fair number of those beasts. The Twilight's Hammer will reel at their losses today.

page.name: Clear 'em Out
page.objective: Kill 8 Cinderscale Whelps and 4 Cinderscale Warriors for Gelinda Coppergleam.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 8 Cinderscale Whelps and 4 Cinderscale Warriors for Gelinda Coppergleam. | Cinderscale Whelp slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Cinderscale Warrior slain | : | 0/ | 4 | Description | If you wanna land a big score, you gotta go where others wouldn't dare! This cave behind me's rich with untapped mineral deposits. I'm talkin' BIG bucks if we can get a crew in there. | There's just this... teeny tiny... dragon problem. It's nothing, really. | If you're willing to go in there and save me the hassle of clearing the dragons out, there's a nice reward in it for you. Not to mention, you'll be in the good graces of a future mining tycoon!

page.name: WANTED: Scoutmaster Vargas
page.objective: Bring the Scoutmaster's Eye to Neza Bloodsnout in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Scoutmaster's Eye to Neza Bloodsnout in Rog'mar. | Scoutmaster's Eye | Description | An Alliance scouting party has been seen on a small island northeast of Rog'mar. They are led by a scoutmaster who has made tracking enemy movements increasingly difficult. The bastard even named his filthy pet after me as an open mockery. He knows I'm hunting him. | This human has eyes everywhere, and they need to be put out. I already claimed one before he managed to flee. Bring me his other as proof that the scoutmaster is no more. Show him he is not as untouchable as he thinks. | -- Neza Bloodsnout | Rewards | You will receive: | Scoutmaster's Eyepatch | Experience: | 4,450 | When you come back | Keep your voice down. The humans are always watching.

page.name: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo
page.objective: Bring the Blademaster's Banner to Ember Bladewhisper in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Blademaster's Banner to Ember Bladewhisper in Farholde Keep. | Blademaster's Banner | Description | With each orc we cut down, another takes its place--somehow even more capable than the last. A skilled warrior must be training this new generation. If we are to make a dent in their numbers, we need to ensure they don't have a chance to recoup their losses. | If any soldier is brave enough, it's imperative we find this blademaster and put an end to him. He is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost even now. Kill him, take his banner, and destroy the orcs' morale. | -- Ember Bladewhisper | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Bladewind | Bladewhisper's Namesake | Experience: | 4,300 | +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Fit for a Princess
page.objective: Collect 3 Coyote Pelts for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 3 Coyote Pelts for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep. | 3 | Coyote Pelt | Description | <Tessa rocks her baby, trying to help her sleep.> | If she isn't hungry, maybe she's just tired. To be honest, Emma here was a delightful surprise, but that means we were a little unprepared. My husband built her this lovely bassinet, but I worry these blankets are too old. She deserves the best, after all. | If you're still willing to help, I would be forever grateful if you could find some pelts for me to line her bed with. If this stops her crying, I think everyone in Farholde would be grateful. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Fur-Lined Bracers | Coyote Hide Wraps | Experience: | 2,850 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Proof of Profit
page.objective: Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam. | Cubic Draconia | Description | My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune. | Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts. | I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.

page.name: Hail the Dragonslayer
page.objective: Take the Head of Scaldaron to Cedric Dalton at the Southern Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Take the Head of Scaldaron to Cedric Dalton at the Southern Watch. | Head of Scaldaron | Description | The dragon's head is all teeth, scale, and ash--a grisly prize taken from a grisly creature. Holding it, you feel the heat of its last fiery breath still radiating from its mouth. | While the threat Scaldaron once posed is no more, the sentries at the Southern Watch ought to know about what happened here. | Rewards | Money: | 1 | 20 | 1 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 4,450 | +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Hail the Dragonslayer
page.objective: Take the Head of Scaldaron to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Take the Head of Scaldaron to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar. | Head of Scaldaron | Description | The dragon's head is all teeth, scale, and ash -- a grisly prize taken from a grisly creature. Holding it, you feel the heat of its last fiery breath still radiating from its mouth. | While the threat Scaldaron once posed is no more, the warriors of Rog'mar ought to know about what happened here. | Rewards | Money: | 1 | 20 | 1 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 4,450

page.name: Foreman's Plight
page.objective: Locate the Foreman's Crate and return it to Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Locate the Foreman's Crate and return it to Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep. | Foreman's Crate | Description | G'day, <lad/lass>. Name's Bertrand, Bertrand Ironbrow! At yer service. | <Bertrand extends a filthy hand.> | These fine folk contracted me tae oversee construction of this here keep. What they lack in experience they make up for in spirit! Problem is, I misplaced me tools. | Had a bit of a run in with a few Twilight in a small grove northwest o' here. Had to choose between me life or me tools. On one hand, I'm alive. On the other... ye see where this is goin'. | Think ye could help find me tools?

page.name: Fetch 'n' Fletch
page.objective: Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into 20 Makeshift Stickin' Spears.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into 20 Makeshift Stickin' Spears. | 20 | Makeshift Stickin' Spear | Description | 'Ey boss-mon, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good. | Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh. | First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back. | Rewards | Money: | 20 | 0 gold, 20 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 2,850 | When you come back | Whatchu find? | When you hand it in | Nice and sharp. Dey gonna stick good.

page.name: Stick 'Em
page.objective: Impale 10 Freshwater Crocolisks then return to Tran'jani in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Impale 10 Freshwater Crocolisks then return to Tran'jani in Rog'mar. | Freshwater Crocolisk impaled | : | 0/ | 10 | Description | You got de spears, now ya gonna learn how to throw dem. | De Riverglades be full o' crocolisks. Nasty tings. Snap you up if ya ain't quick. Perfect for target practice, heheh. | Go stick yourself a bunch of dem. Den you come back to ol' Tran'jani for ya prize. If ya can stick a crocolisk, ya can stick any'ting. | When you hand it in | Impressive work, mon. Ya got de makin's of a real headhunter in ya. Just remember ol' Tan'jani when ya make it big, haha!

page.name: Drink Up!
page.objective: Deliver Zizplink's Frothing Mug to Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver Zizplink's Frothing Mug to Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port. | Provided: | Frothing Mug | Description | Here ya go, champ. One drink for ol' grumpy guts over there. If this doesn't sober him up, nothin' will. | Oh and uh... wash your hands after touchin' this. And don't get it in your eyes.

page.name: Stepped Out
page.objective: Find Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port. | Description | <Tessa's baby continues to wail loudly.> | I guess she isn't tired. Oh... everyone makes it look so easy. Her father always knows how to cheer her up. If only he'd come home already. | â€¹nameâ€º, I hate to ask this, but can you see what is taking him so long? He set out a while ago but he should have been back by now. Emma just lights up when she sees him. | You should find him at Powderfuse Port-- he seems to go there a lot lately. You'll know my Gray when you see him. He shines as brightly as the sun.

page.name: Her World
page.objective: Gather 20 Wildflowers and deliver them to Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 20 Wildflowers and deliver them to Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep. | 20 | Wildflower | Description | Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking... | Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future? | Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.

page.name: Not My Circus
page.objective: Bring 10 Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 10 Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port. | 10 | Briny Seafood Stew | Description | Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity? | You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check? | If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.

page.name: A Feast for Buzzards
page.objective: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Gnawed Skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch. | Provided: | Gnawed Skull | Description | The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery. | You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.

page.name: Song of the Strider
page.objective: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch. | Intact Tallstrider Beak | Description | These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one's especially large. The leader of the nearby pride, most likely. | If rumor spreads about a man-eating lion prowling around on my watch, Demar will be furious. Fortunately, I have a plan. | I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. We can use that to lure the beast out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. There's tallstriders all over the plains. Get me a beak, and make it snappy!

page.name: King of the Wild Plains
page.objective: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch. | Ombassa's Hide | Provided: | Tallstrider Call | Description | The whistle's made, â€¹nameâ€º. | Take it, and go to the top of the hill where the lions are. Should be just north of here. | Once you're there, blow the whistle, and our man-eater should appear. I'd tell you not to come back if you don't manage to kill him, but you'll probably be dead anyhow. | Now then, off with you. Let's see if you fare better than our skeletal friend. | When you come back | If you're talking to me, I assume the lion is slain? | When you hand it in | Ah, so it is! In that case, well done. | Just so we're clear...we agree this matter doesn't need to reach Demar, yes? I'd say we handled it just fine on our own. | The man already stuck me out here. I don't need any more special attention from him.

page.name: Goes Down Smooth
page.objective: Gather 3 Crawler Spittle, Fresh Chum, Goblin Degreaser, and Expired Poison for Innkeeper Zizplink in Powderfuse Port.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 3 Crawler Spittle, Fresh Chum, Goblin Degreaser, and Expired Poison for Innkeeper Zizplink in Powderfuse Port. | 3 | Crawler Spittle | Fresh Chum | Goblin Degreaser | Expired Poison | Description | Talked to Gray, didja? Ball of laughs, that guy. Last thing he needs is you gettin' him another drink. This is an inn not a bar. He's lucky I haven't thrown him out. | You tryin' to take him with you, be my guest. Though I don't think he's in any condition to go anywhere like that. Not without a little goblin pick-me-up. | Why don't ya gather some ingredients for me from this list while I prepare your little friend his 'drink.' We'll see if he still wants booze after he's had my specialty cocktail. | Rewards | You will receive: | 5 | Tessa's Tonic | Experience: | 2,850

page.name: WANTED: Ghostmaw
page.objective: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Wheatley in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Wheatley in Farholde Keep. | Ghostmaw's Fang | Description | It's dangerous enough transportin' horses 'round the glades without talk of some mysterious phantom crocolisk snappin' up my prized ponies! They say this one must be at least three times as big as a regular croc. And twice as mean! | I ain't a gamblin' man. I ain't takin' no chances with my horses till someone puts this good-fer-nothin' monster down. If anyone finds this varmint along the rivers, bring me its tooth so's I know it's safe to travel again. Till then, I'm stayin' put! | -- Wheatley | Rewards | You will receive: | Crocskin Waders | Experience: | 4,300 | +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: WANTED: Ghostmaw
page.objective: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar. | Ghostmaw's Fang | Description | Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh? | Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh! | -- Tan'jani | Rewards | You will receive: | Crocskin Waders | Experience: | 4,300 | When you come back | Ya look like ya seen a ghost, mon. Heheheh. | When you hand it in | Taz'dingo! You be a skilled hunter if ya caught ol' Ghostmaw.

page.name: High Stakes
page.objective: Collect 10 Wood Bundles from Turner's Logging Camp for Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect 10 Wood Bundles from Turner's Logging Camp for Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep. | 10 | Wood Bundle | Description | One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'. | But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood. | With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us? | Rewards | You will receive: | Lumber Luggers | Experience: | 2,150

page.name: A Miner Problem
page.objective: Defeat 5 Ogre Miners and 5 Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
requirements: Ogre Miner slain (5) [DNT] Kill Credit: Ogre Miner Ogre Miner
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Defeat 5 Ogre Miners and 5 Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan. | Ogre Miner slain (5) [DNT] Kill Credit: Ogre Miner Ogre Miner | [DNT] Kill Credit: Ogre Miner | Ogre Miner | Twilight Subjugator slain | : | 0/ | 5 | Description | We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves. | That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks. | Rewards | You will receive: | Twilight Mine Light | Experience: | 3,600 | +100 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: Step Two: More Rock
page.objective: Deliver 10 Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver 10 Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok. | 10 | Heavy Weightstone | Description | Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock. | Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks. | Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon. | Rewards | You will receive: | Plans: Mithril Warhammer | Experience: | 2,450 | +100 reputation with Bolder'ok Clan | When you come back | Smith tinies turn rocks into heavy rock. Genius. Maybe you buy from dem?

page.name: Gaseous Gold
page.objective: Gather 5 Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 5 Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout. | 8 | Marsh Gas Vial | Description | The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though. | If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water. | Rewards | You will receive: | 5 | Riverglades Marsh Gas | Experience: | 2,850

page.name: Rock 'em and Sock 'em
page.objective: Help Sleebo test his creation.
requirements: Fight G45-B4G in a stress test of Sleebo's engine.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Help Sleebo test his creation. | Fight G45-B4G in a stress test of Sleebo's engine. | Description | You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine. | I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected. | Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!

candidates.name: Belle's Ring
candidates.reason: Mount Hyjal chain; primary NPC/objective evidence overrides erroneous Riverglades category

page.name: Belle's Ring
page.objective: Deliver the ring to Michelle Belle at the Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Deliver the ring to Michelle Belle at the Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest. | Thomas's Ring | Description | Yes, Thomas Belle. | <Daythor's demeanor changes suddenly, appearing as though to recall a fond memory of this individual.> | Thomas was one of the first to fall as the scourge laid siege to our outpost. I hadn't heard of his passing until the battle was over. Tragic... He was such a promising young man. | I suppose it would be right for us to deliver this to his beloved Michelle. If memory serves me right, he spoke often of Goldshire. | Rewards | You will receive: | Thomas's Ring | Experience: | 6,200

page.name: Wound Dressings
page.objective: Gather 20 Mageweave Cloth for Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 20 Mageweave Cloth for Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep. | 20 | Mageweave Cloth | Description | If there is one thing a fighting force always needs, it's bandages. Unfortunately, Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth. Thus, we depend on imports from the goblins or, if we are lucky, what we can take back from the orcs. | Currently, our supply of quality cloth is running low. I will have to start making bandages of old shirts before long. If you have the means to aid us, you would be saving many lives.

page.name: Doctor's Orderly
page.objective: Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley. | Wounded Soldier treated | : | 0/ | 3 | Provided: | Makeshift Bandages | Description | I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid. | Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.

page.name: Clerical Quarantine
page.objective: Speak to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep. | Description | You have done all you can here, for now. | If you wish to be of further aid, go up the hill to the chapel. It is the smaller building outside the main church. | Sister Rowland is looking after a few quarantined soldiers there who have contracted an unknown illness.

page.name: Something's in the Water
page.objective: Collect a sample of drinking water from the plains for Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Collect a sample of drinking water from the plains for Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep. | Filled Freshwater Phial | Description | I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water. | I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.

page.name: Upstream Contamination
page.objective: Find whatever creature is causing the drinking water contamination and eliminate it. Then, return to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find whatever creature is causing the drinking water contamination and eliminate it. Then, return to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep. | Contaminant eliminated | Description | The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic. | I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature. | Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde. | Rewards | You will receive: | 3 | Superior Healing Potion | Experience: | 4,300 | +150 reputation with Brotherhood of the Horse

page.name: A Feast for Buzzards
page.objective: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Gnawed Skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar. | Provided: | Gnawed Skull | Description | The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery. | You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to a hunter at Rog'mar and see what they know. | When you come back | You bring something from the plains? | When you hand it in | <Neza runs her fingers along the markings left on the skull. Her smile grows as she does so.> | Two pieces of good news. First, this is a human skull. Second, we have a great hunt on our hands.

page.name: Song of the Strider
page.objective: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar. | Intact Tallstrider Beak | Description | These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride. | I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you. | I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. | There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin! | When you come back | I have been making whistles and animal calls since I was young. It is a useful skill when hunting certain prey. | When you hand it in | Good find, priest. I will only need a moment to carve this into the proper shape.

page.name: King of the Wild Plains
page.objective: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar. | Ombassa's Hide | Provided: | Tallstrider Call | Description | The whistle is made, â€¹nameâ€º. | Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell. | Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear. | I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory. | When you come back | Come to bring news of your victory? | When you hand it in | And so you are! Well done! | These plains are a tough land, â€¹nameâ€º. You have shown yourself to be even tougher.

page.name: Feathers for Fletching
page.objective: Bring 6 Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 6 Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar. | 6 | Plains Buzzard Feather | Description | A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky. | Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work. | The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few? | When you come back | A bit ironic to pluck something from the corpse of a buzzard, isn't it? | When you hand it in | These will catch the wind nicely. My arrows will fly true. Thank you, priest.

page.name: Poison Tips
page.objective: Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar. | 4 | Glade Viper Venom | Description | Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey. | This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job. | Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter. | The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it. | When you come back | Be careful while gathering the vipers' venom that you do not succumb to it yourself. | When you hand it in | This is enough venom to kill a kodo in minutes--or a human in seconds. In either case, I am eager to put it to use.

page.name: A Hunter's Quiver
page.objective: Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar. | 6 | Prized Lion Hide | Description | As important as a hunter's weapons is her quiver. A good quiver holds many arrows, while not being so large as to slow the wearer down. It must be durable, and fit snugly onto the body. | Around here, there is no better material for a quiver than the pelts of lions. They are already well-suited for the life of a hunter on the plains. | The lions gather on a hill to the south. You can see it from here. Please, bring me their pelts. | Rewards | You will receive: | Matriarch Quiver | Experience: | 3,150 | When you come back | Like us, the lions hunt in packs. Be on your guard, and make sure you are not surrounded. | When you hand it in | Arrows, poison, and a quiver to hold it all. You have made quite the hunter's kit here. | Please, take something in exchange for your labor. May it serve you well out in the field.

page.name: In Need of Relief
page.objective: Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok. | Description | Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break. | At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing. | Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return. | Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.

page.name: An Ogre's Captive
page.objective: Find Gronok the Butcher, kill him, and bring Dunston the key to his shackles.
page.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Find Gronok the Butcher, kill him, and bring Dunston the key to his shackles. | Gronok's Key | Description | I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me. | As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep. | While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement. | I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. | My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?
